description: Check the status of a conversion job. Returns persisted status per the OpenAPI ConversionStatus enum (queued, analyzing, building, rendering, labeling, generating, validating, uploading, done, failed). The tool-layer bucket `processing` means still in progress — it is not a persisted API value. Also returns progress, download/preview availability, and recommended_next (which tool to call next). When done and downloadable, recommended_next points to wpconvert_download_result; for preview-only jobs it points to wpconvert_create_preview instead.
name: wpconvert_check_status
